<includeonly><tr><td>{{{anchors|}}}{{{ingredients|No item inputs}}}</td><td>{{{output|Not established}}}</td><td>{{{methods|Not established}}}</td><td>{{#if:{{{ap|}}}|{{{ap}}} base [[Action points|AP]]|{{{cost|Not established}}}}}</td><td>{{{conditions|Not established}}}</td></tr>
</includeonly><noinclude>
A presentation row inside an existing recipe table:
<pre>{{Recipe row
|ingredients={{Item|Plant Fiber|quantity=4}}
|output={{Item|Bandage|quantity=1}}
|methods=[[Inventory crafting]]
|ap=2
|conditions=Example only; use the documented requirements.
}}</pre>
This example illustrates syntax, not a verified recipe. Use nested Item calls separated by <nowiki><br /></nowiki> for multiple ingredients or outputs. Fractional base AP is supported. If a cost has another unit, supply cost instead of ap. Missing values say "Not established"; zero is not unknown. Output may describe an in-place construction instead of inventing an inventory item.

Keep literal onlyinclude/view/station filters and stable anchors on the owning output article. Put the row call inside those filters; this template does not inherit caller parameters or own facts. Workstations continue transcluding filtered rows.
</noinclude>
